articles.headline: Wild stats from NFL Week 4 featuring Cowboys, Bears, Eagles, Seahawks, more
articles.description: Sunday featured wild plays, historic numbers and a game that started with two straight interceptions. Catch up on the day's most interesting stats.
articles.headlineJa: NFL第4週の驚愕のスタッツ：カウボーイズ、ベアーズ、イーグルス、シーホークスなど
articles.descriptionJa: 日曜日は衝撃的なプレーや歴史的な数字が飛び出し、2回連続のインターセプトで幕を開けた試合もありました。この日の最も興味深いスタッツを振り返ります。
articles.body:
There was a moment in Sunday's early NFL window in which the Rams made it a one-score game, the Texans took the lead, the Bills took the lead and the Bengals made it a one-score game all within sixty seconds of one another. If the feeling of watching that were bottled and sold on the market, I would mortgage my house for it.

Every Sunday, I'll find several of the coolest advanced stats from the day's NFL action to share with you -- stats to explain all the action and what it means. Some call them NFL Next Gen Stats. I call them Next Ben Stats: the data that might not make it on the broadcast but will make you a smarter fan (and laugh a little bit, probably).

Let's start Week 4's list with a historic day for a Cowboys receiver, an NFC North offense and game-opening interceptions.

Jump to an eye-popping stat on:

Lamb tallies 17 catches | 0-4 teams to make playoffs

Rams blitzed Hurts A LOT | Bears out-offensed the Jets

Back-to-back interceptions

17: Number of catches for CeeDee Lamb in the Cowboys' win over the Texans

There were only 11 players Sunday with 17 or more rushes. That's the incredible volume at which Lamb was just used. It's only the ninth game in NFL history in which a player had 17-plus catches.

The Texans spent much of the game letting the Cowboys play Lamb in the slot and hunt nickel Jalen Pitre in space -- and then again with rookie Kamari Ramsey when the Texans were in dime. Lamb saw 42.1% of his targets on the day from the slot, which is the second-highest slot share he has had since Brian Schottenheimer took over as head coach last year.

When Lamb was out wide, the Cowboys threw him hitches incessantly -- almost any time they saw off-coverage from the Texans' outside corners. This was a game in which the Cowboys' offensive coaching staff dared the Texans' defensive coaching staff to continue sticking to their characteristically simple defensive approach. Houston refused to blink, and the Cowboys took the free yardage again and again and again.

Houston's defense was a vaunted group last season. This year, they've had too many easy holes -- especially in end-of-game situations in which the ball is coming out faster than their pass rush can account for it. This Lamb performance is but an extreme example.

1: How many 0-4 teams have made the playoffs since the start of the 1990 season

The Texans will drive to become the second. To be fair, the Chargers, Titans, Bucs and Dolphins are also trying this. The Texans' attempt just feels a little more legitimate.

Houston has lost three of four games by one score, and all three of those losses have had a score change within the final two minutes. In the Texans' 34-30 loss to the Cowboys, Houston had a win probability as high as 78.5% with two minutes left in the fourth quarter.

articles.headline: Brock Purdy throws 2 TD passes to lead the undefeated 49ers past the Broncos 24-14
articles.description: — Brock Purdy threw two touchdown passes and Christian McCaffrey ran for a score to lead the undefeated San Francisco 49ers to a 24-14 victory over the
articles.headlineJa: ブロック・パーディがTDパス2本を記録し、無敗の49ersがブロンコスに24-14で勝利
articles.descriptionJa: ブロック・パーディが2本のタッチダウンパスを投げ、クリスチャン・マッキャフリーがランで得点を挙げ、無敗のサンフランシスコ・49ersがブロンコスに24-14で勝利しました。
articles.body:
SANTA CLARA, Calif. -- — Brock Purdy threw two touchdown passes and Christian McCaffrey ran for a score to lead the undefeated San Francisco 49ers to a 24-14 victory over the Denver Broncos on Sunday.


              Both offenses struggled to generate offense on a hot day in the Bay Area, but the 49ers (4-0) took advantage of a fumbled punt return by Marvin Mims Jr. to set up a short touchdown drive in the third quarter that gave them the lead for good.


              Purdy capped the 28-yard drive with a 1-yard touchdown pass to Deebo Samuel that made it 10-3 late in the third quarter. He then engineered a 74-yard drive that McCaffrey finished with a 1-yard run to extend the lead to 17-6 midway through the fourth after the Broncos (2-2) had settled for a field goal on fourth-and-2.


              Bo Nix, who has thrived in late-game comeback situations, tried to mount another for Denver with his 13-yard touchdown pass to Jaylen Waddle cutting the Niners' lead to 17-14 with a 2-point conversion with 4:05 to play.


              But Purdy sealed the win with a 56-yard touchdown pass to George Kittle with 2:15 to go. Purdy finished 19 of 30 for 218 yards and avoided taking a sack for a fourth straight game and committing no turnovers.


              Nix struggled to push the ball downfield most of the game with Denver's running game unable to loosen up the defense. He finished 25 of 42 for 214 yards and one touchdown.


              The 49ers came in scoring touchdowns on nearly half of their possessions, but struggled to move the ball against Denver's stout defense. They punted on two of their first three possessions with Purdy getting stopped on a fourth-down sneak on the other.


              San Francisco got on the board with a 24-yard field goal to tie it late in the first half, but had a chance to take the lead thwarted when a field goal was blocked on the final play of the first half to keep the game tied at 3.


              Injuries
              Broncos: CB Patrick Surtain (ankle), CB Riley Moss (ribs) and WR Pat Bryant (ankle) all left with injuries and didn't return.


              49ers: FB Kyle Juszczyk left with a knee injury after being hit by Jahdae Barron and didn't return.


              Up next
              Broncos: Visit the Los Angeles Chargers next Sunday.


              49ers: Visit Seattle next Sunday.


              ------

articles.headline: Spurs' Tobias Harris to miss preseason with left calf strain
articles.description: Spurs free agent acquisition Tobias Harris sustained a calf strain during camp that has him questionable for the team's Oct. 20 season opener vs. OKC.
articles.headlineJa: スパーズのトバイアス・ハリス、左ふくらはぎの挫傷でプレシーズンを欠場
articles.descriptionJa: スパーズがフリーエージェントで獲得したトバイアス・ハリスが、キャンプ中にふくらはぎを挫傷。10月20日のOKC戦でのシーズン開幕戦への出場は不透明となっている。
articles.body:
SAN ANTONIO -- The San Antonio Spurs announced before tipoff of their intrasquad scrimmage Sunday that free-agent acquisition Tobias Harris suffered a strained left calf during training camp that leaves him questionable for the Oct. 20 season opener against Oklahoma City.

A teams spokesman said that Harris would miss Sunday's scrimmage and will be re-evaluated after the preseason.

Harris, 34, signed a two-year, $31 million deal in July to join the Spurs, leaving a Detroit Pistons team that he helped lead a franchise turnaround over the previous two seasons.

A productive veteran lauded for knocking down shots and floor spacing in the frontcourt, Harris was expected to begin the season in San Antonio's starting lineup.

Harris averaged 13.5 points and 5.6 rebounds per game in his second stint in Detroit, as the Pistons improved from one of the league's worst teams two years ago to capturing 60 victories last season and advancing in the playoffs for the first time since 2008.

Harris served as one of the few veterans on a Pistons team that ranked as one of the NBA's youngest. The veteran signed a two-year $52 million deal with Detroit in 2024 as a free agency, after spending six seasons with the Philadelphia 76ers.

articles.headline: Unbeaten Vikings keep Dolphins winless with dominant defense, Reichard's kicks, Hockenson's catches
articles.description: — The Minnesota Vikings stayed undefeated with more dominance by their defense and five field goals from Will Reichard, sidestepping their early passing game problems to secure a 15-10 victory...
articles.headlineJa: 無敗のバイキングス、圧倒的な守備とライハードのキック、ホッケンソンのキャッチでドルフィンズの初勝利を阻止
articles.descriptionJa: ミネソタ・バイキングスは、さらに支配的な守備とウィル・ライハードによる5本のフィールドゴールで無敗を維持。序盤のパスゲームの問題を乗り越え、15-10で勝利を収めました。
articles.body:
MINNEAPOLIS -- — The Minnesota Vikings stayed undefeated with more dominance by their defense and five field goals from Will Reichard, sidestepping their early passing game problems to secure a 15-10 victory over the winless Miami Dolphins on Sunday.


              T.J. Hockenson had a career-high-tying 13 receptions for 119 yards on 13 targets from Kyler Murray, including the game-sealing 8-yard catch on third-and-5 from the 10. Hockenson was wide open and could've coasted into the end zone, but he wisely slid in front of the goal line to drain the clock down to the two-minute warning.


              With the Dolphins out of timeouts, the Vikings had Murray take three straight kneel-downs to move to 4-0 for the second time in three years.


              The Dolphins, who are 0-4 for the first time since 2019 in their first season under coach Brian Flores, were crushed by a combination of unforced mistakes and a bit of bad luck.


              New Dolphins quarterback Malik Willis went just 9 for 17 for 85 yards, losing a fumble during one of the two sacks by Dallas Turner. Willis thought he had escaped the relentless Vikings pass rush to float a 68-yard touchdown pass to Chris Bell early in the second quarter, but Bell was flagged for illegal touching after stepping out of bounds as he moved to get open while Willis scrambled toward the sideline.


              The Vikings had 11 penalties for 85 yards, but they dodged a costly flag when Ivan Pace Jr. had a call for roughing the kicker waved off when the video replay assist system determined he tipped Bradley Pinion's punt and therefore didn't commit a penalty.


              After netting just 76 yards on 21 plays in the first half and failing to finish any possession across midfield, the Dolphins finally found a couple of creases in Minnesota’s otherwise-suffocating defense directed by Flores, who's in his fourth year as coordinator.


              Ollie Gordon, in an elevated role following the season-ending knee injury to star running back De’Vone Achane, ripped off a career-long 53-yard run on third-and-5 to set up Riley Patterson’s 27-yard field goal. Gordon had a 12-yard touchdown run on the next drive to pull the Dolphins within 12-10 late in the third quarter.


              Reichard, who stretched the NFL 's longest active streak to 31 consecutive made field goals, drew a loud roar from the otherwise restless crowd at U.S. Bank Stadium when he was shown on the videoboard during the two-minute warning.


              Murray finished 27 for 37 for 247 yards without a turnover, but he took four sacks for 34 yards against a Dolphins defense that had none in the first three games and was often tentative and unsteady in the pocket until Hockenson helped him open up the field with a handful of clutch and difficult catches.

articles.body:
Whom should you start? Whom should you sit? To help you set your fantasy football lineups and avoid starting an offensive player who won't be in the lineup, we'll post fantasy-relevant updates and analysis here as NFL teams release their official inactives lists. 

Official Sunday inactives should begin coming in approximately 90 minutes before the scheduled kickoff times: around 11:30 a.m. ET for the early games and 2:30 p.m. ET for the late-afternoon games.

Refresh often for the latest information.

Don't forget to check these out: Mike Clay's Playbook | Week 4 Buzz 

Week 4 Rankings | Matchup rankings for Week 4

Biggest concerns heading into Week 4

Players in London 

Chig Okonkwo, TE, Commanders (hamstring): He has been limited in practice this week but is active. Okonkwo has missed the past two games and, though it is encouraging to have him back, I would not risk getting him into your lineups right away. After all, he will likely be third in the target pecking order in a game started by a backup QB. There is some upside long term, though, with Daniels potentially nearing a return. Okonkwo is a stash for TE-needy teams.

 Terry McLaurin, WR, Commanders (hamstring): Washington's top receiver was added to the injury report Friday and is indeed inactive for Sunday's game. Stefon Diggs was already a strong start as both the top slot option for the Commanders and man-coverage target. The Colts have allowed the most yards to slot receivers and play man at the third-highest rate in the NFL. With McLaurin sitting, Diggs gets an added boost in volume.

Players with early starts

ACTIVE

Lamar Jackson, QB, Ravens (back): Jackson scared away fantasy managers when he was limited in Wednesday's practice because of a back injury. He later returned to full practice and is active in Week 4. Never bench him in fantasy.

Zay Flowers, WR, Ravens (hamstring): Flowers was questionable headed into the weekend but is indeed active for today's game. He has earned must-start status as the clear focal point of the Ravens' passing attack.

DJ Moore, WR, Bills (shoulder): Buffalo's top receiver had been limited in practice and even wore a red noncontact jersey. That's the same thing that happened last week, and Moore ended up playing and getting 10 targets. He is active for Week 4. Also working in Moore's favor is that Patriots star CB Christian Gonzalez is out this week. Moore is Buffalo's top target when going against man defense, and New England uses that coverage at the second-highest NFL rate. He should be started in all leagues this week.

D'Andre Swift, RB, Bears (knee): Swift was added to the team's official injury report Thursday, but did not carry an injury designation heading into Sunday. He is active and fantasy managers can start him without worry.

articles.headline: Pistons' Jalen Duren happy to return despite prolonged talks
articles.description: Despite a prolonged negotiation that appeared to turn sour at times, Jalen Duren said he is relieved and excited to return to Detroit.
articles.headlineJa: ピストンズのジェイレン・デュレン、長期にわたる交渉を経て復帰を喜ぶ
articles.descriptionJa: 時には険悪なムードに陥った長期の交渉を経て、ジェイレン・デュレンはデトロイトに復帰できることに安堵と喜びを感じていると語った。
articles.body:
Jalen Duren was both relieved and excited after signing a new five-year, $200 million deal to return to the Detroit Pistons after a contract negotiation that he said took "longer than both he and the organization anticipated."

But during his first news conference after signing his new deal, he wanted to clarify narratives that emerged during the negotiation that he said did not represent how he felt about the team, repeating that he was happy in Detroit and excited to return to the team.

"Detroit has become a home for me, this is where I live full-time," Duren told reporters at the team's practice facility on Sunday afternoon. "The city has embraced me as well as I've embraced the city.

"This process took way longer than any of us really wanted. Longer than I wanted, and I'm sure longer than the organization wanted. But [the Pistons] have a job to do as well as my team and my agency have a job to do to make the best outcome for both sides. I feel like we've done that."

 

Duren missed media day and the first few practices of training camp this week after a four-month long standoff between he and the Pistons over the value of his new contract. They eventually came to an agreement on a fully guaranteed contract late Thursday night, ahead of the deadline for him to accept a one-year qualifying offer.

On Sunday, sitting next to team president of basketball operations Trajan Langdon, Duren said he wanted to be in Detroit for the rest of his career.

"There's a business component that it took me time to realize and understand because this is my first time going through it," the 22-year old All-NBA center said. "I can admit that I have flaws. We all do and we're here to work on it.

"I don't think this should be a negative outlook or looked at as something bad has happened. I think we look at it as something great has happened. I'm locked in with a team and a core who has potential that's going through the roof and I'm super excited for what's to come."

The standoff over Duren's contract came following the best regular season of the young center's career. He averaged a career high in points (19.5), made his first All-Star team and was named to the All-NBA third team as the Pistons became the top seed in the Eastern Conference. But he struggled mightily in the postseason, dropping to 10.2 points per game in 14 playoff games before Detroit's second-round exit.

Duren said he took a step back to get his head right following a postseason he described as "humbling," and he acknowledged his own silence allowed narratives to emerge in his absence. But he said he stayed focused in the offseason on getting better and acknowledging his flaws.

"Last season was some of my highest moments in my career and some of my lowest," Duren said. "I'm willing to acknowledge that. articles.descriptionJa: アーセナル、レアル・マドリード、バイエルン・ミュンヘンが、ユヴェントスのウィング、ケナン・ユルディズの獲得を争っている。最新の移籍情報をお届けする。
articles.body:
Arsenal, Real Madrid and Bayern Munich are all chasing Juventus winger Kenan Yildiz. Plus, could Endrick leave Real Madrid for AC Milan?

Join us for the latest transfer news and rumors from around the globe.

Transfers home page | Men's summer grades | Women's grades

Trending rumors

- Real Madrid are pushing for Kenan Yildiz with Arsenal and Bayern Munich also looking at the Juventus winger, reports Corriere dello Sport. Juve have been demanding at least €100 million for the 21-year-old for a year, but Madrid are reigniting their interest in him with the view to a move in the summer. They would want to pit him and Vinícius Júnior against each other, while Arsenal see the Turkiye international as the answer to their lack of options on the left and Bayern have been watching him from afar since his departure.

- AC Milan are planning to make another attempt to sign Real Madrid striker Endrick after being unable to bring him in during the summer, reports La Gazzetta dello Sport. Madrid boss Jose Mourinho had initially refused to let the 20-year-old leave, but he has made just one substitute appearance this season that lasted four minutes. Milan's main competition from within Italy for the Brazil international is Roma, while Aston Villa were also unsuccessful in their efforts to bring him in last summer.

- Barcelona are willing to let Alejandro Balde leave on loan in January with Manchester United among the clubs interested in the left-back, according to TEAMtalk. The 22-year-old has fallen down the pecking order in Hansi Flick's squad and has only got onto the pitch once so far this season, playing the last 12 minutes in a 7-2 win over Racing Santander. The Spaniard's camp and intermediaries are already working hard to find a solution for him, while the Blaugrana could look to bring in a new left-back in 2027.

- Liverpool center back Giovanni Leoni is the latest name La Gazzetta dello Sport have linked with Juventus, as I Bianconeri aim to introduce young Italian talent to their squad. The Serie A side have turned their attention away from the likes of Arsenal's Riccardo Calafiori and Chelsea's Marco Palestra, who are now seen as unattainable, and had already made enquiries about a loan for Leoni in recent months. Liverpool haven't opened the door to the 19-year-old leaving, but Juventus aren't giving up on him.

- Barcelona are interested in 18-year-old FC Twente center back Ruud Nijstad, reports transfer journalist Fabrizio Romano. They are monitoring the young Dutchman, having already made contact about him in August but ultimately being told that a transfer wasn't possible as Twente wanted him to be a key player for them. More clubs are showing an interest in Nijstad and have started travelling to scout him.

- Real Madrid are among the clubs who could move to sign Manchester United attacker JJ Gabriel, according to Spanish newspaper AS. Various clubs across Europe are looking at the 15-year-old after it was made clear that he wants to leave

articles.headline: Who most deserves the Ballon d'Or? Whittling down the 30-man short list
articles.description: Kylian Mbappé, Lamine Yamal and Harry Kane are the three favorites to win the 2026 Ballon d'Or, but who actually deserves to win it?
articles.headlineJa: バロンドールに最もふさわしいのは誰か？30人の候補リストを絞り込む
articles.descriptionJa: キリアン・エムバペ、ラミン・ヤマル、ハリー・ケインが2026年バロンドールの3大本命だが、真に受賞に値するのは誰か？
articles.body:
For most of the past 15 years, there was really no point in campaigning for the men's Ballon d'Or -- it was going to the more obnoxiously successful of two men, Lionel Messi (eight-time winner) or Cristiano Ronaldo (five). Their personal -- and sometimes club -- rivalry defined the sport, to the point where even a rising star like Kylian Mbappé openly admitted he wasn't as good as them.

"It's not only me who knows that," he told writer Simon Kuper in "The Barcelona Complex." "Everyone knows it. If you tell yourself that you'll do better than them, it's beyond ego or determination -- it's lack of awareness. Those players are incomparable. They have broken all laws of statistics."

"I can't top them" probably isn't the healthiest thing in the world for a megastar to tell himself, but with Messi and Ronaldo finally having aged out of the competition -- Ronaldo hasn't finished in the top three of the voting in the 2020s, and Messi's final win came in 2023 -- now's the time to pounce.

Mbappé wants it. Lamine Yamal has said he wants it. Harry Kane thinks winning it would be "amazing." They're the three betting favorites for the award -- Kane's and Yamal's odds are both at +100 after a recent rise from Yamal, while Mbappé is at a longer +1000 -- but who actually deserves it?

After some late PR campaigns from players and clubs, voting for the award closed on Monday. It will go to the player who achieved the most between the beginning of the 2025-26 club season and the end of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Thirty players were officially nominated, but based on who has won the award in the past, we can narrow the field pretty quickly.

- Ogden: Does Man City's guilty verdict impact Pep Guardiola's legacy?

- Marcotti: Hard to see how City recover from extraordinary guilty verdict

- Lindop: Liverpool can't afford to be without Isak, Gakpo in October

Eliminate anyone who played for Real Madrid last season

Eliminated: Jude Bellingham, Kylian Mbappé, Vinícius Júnior

I'm sorry, but we have to start here. The three players above are all dynamite, and two have come pretty close to winning the award already -- Mbappé was 192 points behind Messi in 2023, and Vinícius was only 41 points behind Rodri in 2024.

Mbappé is indeed No. 3 in the betting odds, and his scorpionlike quick strike capabilities might make him the most terrifying player in the world. At any point, it feels as if you could be about eight seconds from a Mbappé goal. He's great.

He has also been part of a terribly disappointing club team for two straight years. Since Mbappé joined Real Madrid, the only trophies they've won were the UEFA Super Cup and the FIFA Intercontinental Cup in 2024, trophies tied to accomplishments of the team before his arrival.

Real Madrid have finished behind Barcelona in both of Mbappé's seasons, and after winning the UEFA Champions League in the season before his arrival, they haven't made it past the quarterfinals with him. The Ballon d'Or isn't for club underachiever

articles.headline: Which Premier League players got injured in the international break?
articles.description: All the latest news and updates on Premier League stars injuries during the first international break of the 2026-2027 club season
articles.headlineJa: プレミアリーグのどの選手が代表ウィーク中に負傷したか？
articles.descriptionJa: 2026-2027クラブシーズン最初の代表ウィークにおける、プレミアリーグのスター選手たちの負傷に関する最新ニュースとアップデート。
articles.body:
Premier League teams will be watching and hoping their star players remain healthy throughout the international break.

However, some have already sustained injuries while playing for their countries. Premier League matches resume on Oct. 10.

ESPN will be tracking the latest injuries and updates for your club's players:

Kai Havertz (Arsenal)

Arsenal's Kai Havertz was forced off in the 30th minute of the game between Netherlands and Germany on September 24th with what was described as a muscle injury.

"Both are currently undergoing an MRI," Jurgen Klopp said on RTL about Havertz and Jamal Musiala. "I hope we get the diagnosis [on Thursday] evening. But of course, this isn't great. I hope it's nothing serious. The lads are probably out for us. But hopefully, they'll be back in action relatively quickly."

On September 25 the German Football Association confirmed the attacker would be leaving Klopp's camp and return to Arsenal after suffering what they describe as a 'muscle strain.'

Brian Brobbey (Sunderland)

The powerful Sunderland attacker was also injured in the same game after picking up what looked like a hamstring injury while running for the ball. He immediately went down and signalled to the sideline.

He left the field of his own accord but did have a heavy limp as he walked down the tunnel.

Netherlands boss Xavi Hernandez said after the game: "Brian is indeed injured."

Brobbey was replaced by Joshua Zirkzee in the Dutch squad.

Zion Suzuki (Aston Villa)

The goalkeeper linked up with the Japan squad but according to reports missed the main group training session on September 22nd, according to local reports. Instead he was put on an individual session for a rib injury.

Suzuki was subsequently left out of Japan's matchday squad entirely for Thursday's 3-1 victory over Uruguay.

Dan Ballard (Sunderland)

The Sunderland defender suffered a reported hamstring injury during Northern Ireland's 1-0 victory over Georgia in the UEFA Nations League.

With the score still 0-0 as the match moved into stoppage time, Ballard chased back as Georgia counter-attacked and pulled up clutching the back of his thigh, unable to finish the match in Tbilisi.

Speaking immediately after Friday's match, manager Michael O'Neill said it was too soon to know the extent of his latest injury but will definitely miss the next three Northern Ireland games.

"We'll scan him tomorrow (Saturday), but he's certainly not going to be available for the next three games."

Alexander Isak (Liverpool)

Alexander Isak is returning to Liverpool after sustaining a "minor injury" on international duty.

The striker scored and played the full 90 minutes in Sweden's 2-1 victory over Romania in the Nations League on Friday.

But Isak, who has made a strong start to the season for Liverpool, will not feature in matches against Poland, Bosnia and Herzegovina and Romania over the remainder of the extended international break.

Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United)

articles.headlineJa: レイカーズのザイア・ウィリアムズ、ブルーノ・マーズのツアーで長年の恋人にプロポーズ
articles.descriptionJa: イングルウッドでの5公演のうち2公演目、歌手のブルーノ・マーズがこのプロポーズを盛り上げた。
articles.body:
Pop superstar Bruno Mars knows how to put on a good show. But on Friday night, one audience member seemed to steal the show from the 16-time Grammy winner.

As Mars performed "Marry You" during his second night of five in Inglewood, California, for "The Romantic Tour," Los Angeles Lakers forward Ziaire Williams found the perfect moment to make a promise for forever.

On the floor level of SoFi Stadium, Williams got down on bended knee as Mars sang the words "I think I wanna marry you," lining up his question -- "Will you marry me?" -- with the lyrics.

As Williams proposed to his teary-eyed girlfriend, model Paris Timan, Mars blended his singing with his excitement, crooning, "Please say I do I do I do."

After Timan -- who seemed to be in shock -- said yes, Mars continued singing through the song's conclusion while the couple shared a hug as the audience erupted in cheers.

Timan will be part of two new beginnings for Williams. In July, the 25-year-old signed a one-year, $3 million deal with the Lakers after a 2025-26 season in which he posted 10.2 points and 2.4 rebounds per game in 54 games with the Brooklyn Nets.

And the next part? Planning the rest of their lives together. Nothing screams "fairy tale" more than a proposal to a Mars love song.

articles.headline: LeBron James calls scrimmage 'great first step' for new-look 76ers
articles.description: Throngs of fans waited in lines more than 10-deep to watch LeBron James, Jaylen Brown and the rest of the 76ers take part in Saturday's scrimmage.
articles.headlineJa: レブロン・ジェームズ、新体制の76ersにとって練習試合は「素晴らしい第一歩」と評価
articles.descriptionJa: 土曜日の練習試合に出場したレブロン・ジェームズ、ジェイレン・ブラウン、そして76ersのメンバーを見るため、多くのファンが10列以上の長い列を作って待機した。
articles.body:
PHILADELPHIA -- It might have been the basketball equivalent of a dress rehearsal, but the 76ers' intrasquad scrimmage Saturday certainly gave a promising glimpse of what could be in store when the curtain actually comes up for the 2026-27 NBA season.

Philadelphia hosted its annual Blue-White game in front of approximately 10,000 fans at Xfinity Mobile Arena, moving the exhibition from their G League affiliate's home in Delaware to accommodate the added interest in the new-look team.

While throngs of fans waited in lines more than 10-deep in the atrium an hour before the noon start, there was plenty of on-court action from LeBron James, Jaylen Brown & Co. to enjoy as soon as the scrimmage started.

"To be able to take what we've done on the practice floor, bring it to a game floor situation around our fans ... it was a great first step in the direction we're trying to go," James said.

Longtime Sixers public address announcer Matt Cord, who had retired before deciding to come back once Philadelphia had its historic summer, announced the starters for the Blue team.

First Tyrese Maxey, then VJ Edgecombe, then Brown, then James and then the man in the middle who has been with the franchise for 13 years.

"7-2 from Cameroon, No. 21, Joel 'The Processsss' Embiiddddd!" Cord bellowed.

"It doesn't matter who gets announced first, last, second, third," Embiid said.

But the cheers that followed every name did mean something to him.

"We love the fans," Embiid said. "We want them, and we need them to be part of this. I mentioned it at media day: It's already hard enough to win as a group that gets together for the first year. So we're going to need all we can, whether it's from everybody in this building, the fans, the outside people, we're going to need to get together. We're going to need all the support possible."

The Sixers didn't keep an official box score, but the stats mattered far less than some of the sequences that showed the early chemistry that is developing after a week of training camp, including James finding a trailing Embiid for an above-the-break 3.

"Guys are going to use their speed against people and try to score a quick basket, and if we don't have anything, I'm the trail guy," Embiid said matter-of-factly.

Both Maxey and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope delivered feeds to James for alley-oop dunks that the 41-year-old star finished with ease. Embiid got his 7-foot frame to lift high enough to both block springy second-year guard Edgecombe and have a dunk of his own.

"Pretty good, not bad," a noticeably slimmed-down Embiid said when asked how he felt physically compared to last season. Then he showed his sense of humor is as strong as ever.

"That's probably the last dunk of my career," Embiid said with a smirk.

While James has had only four official Sixers practices, plus the scrimmage, it was enough for him to conclude that Embiid is a different player than the guy he won a gold medal with at the Paris Olympics two summers ago.

And Barcelona will be looking to put themselves in pole position for his signature alongside Real Madrid if he does become available.

The Catalan giants ultimately opted to sign Gabriel Jesus from Arsenal, but could revisit a move for the 22-year-old Germany Under-21 international in a future transfer window.

Internazionale, Atalanta and Lazio are all monitoring the Italy international, who is seeking regular first-team football after struggling for opportunities at Anfield.

articles.headline: Sources: Grizzlies waive Jordan Hawkins weeks after Pels trade
articles.description: The Memphis Grizzlies and guard Jordan Hawkins have agreed to part ways via waivers, allowing the 2023 lottery pick to find a new home in free agency, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.
articles.headlineJa: 情報筋：グリズリーズ、ペリカンズとのトレードから数週間でジョーダン・ホーキンスをウェイブ
articles.descriptionJa: メンフィス・グリズリーズとガードのジョーダン・ホーキンスがウェイブによる放出に合意し、2023年のロタリーピックである彼がフリーエージェントとして新天地を探すことになったと、ESPNのシャムス・チャラニアに情報筋が伝えた。
articles.body:
The Memphis Grizzlies and guard Jordan Hawkins have agreed to part ways via waivers, allowing the 2023 lottery pick to find a new home in free agency, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.

The move comes three weeks after arriving as part of a four-player trade with the New Orleans Pelicans for AJ Johnson and Taj Gibson.

Hawkins, 24, averaged 5.1 points in 51 games last season and struggled to find consistent playing time in New Orleans' crowded backcourt rotation. The former UConn star played just 13.6 minutes per game, a significant decrease from the 2024-25 season, when he played 23.6 minutes per game and averaged 10.8 points per game.

Hawkins, a perimeter shooter, was selected 14th by the Pelicans in the 2023 draft, two years before a regime change that saw Joe Dumars replace David Griffin as basketball operations chief.

Trending rumors

- Jadon Sancho is willing to hold out until January as a free agent before making a decision, if the right offer doesn't arrive before then, reports TEAMtalk. The former Manchester United and Borussia Dortmund winger is a free agent, following his exit from Old Trafford at the end of his contract in the summer. The 26-year-old has been linked with a whole host of clubs since, but is yet to make a decision on his future, with nothing advanced on his next club.

- Manchester United and Chelsea are monitoring a deal for Benfica defender Tomás Araújo, according to TEAMTalk. The 24-year-old is claimed to be on the radar of several Premier League clubs, but it's United and Chelsea who are most keen. Araujo, who can play center back and right-back, recently signed a contract extension until 2031, making an exit in January unlikely. However, with a release clause valued at £68 million, clubs could pursue a switch anyway

- Juventus are preparing a huge rebuild over the next year, with Tuttosport naming a whole host of potential transfer targets for the Italian club. In the goalkeeping ranks, Alisson Becker is claimed to be a player of interest, as he could leave Liverpool at the end of the season as a free agent. In defence, Oumar Solet of Udinese is viewed as an option, while RB Leipzig ace David Raum and Crystal Palace star Tyrick Mitchell are also on the Bianconeri's radar. Napoli stalwart Stanislav Lobotka, Manchester City midfielder Mateo Kovacic, and Real Madrid playmaker Brahim Díaz are touted as options for the central ranks. Meanwhile, Crystal Palace forward Jean-Philippe Mateta could be a striker arrival.

- João Félix is keen on making a return to Barcelona next year, when the Portuguese international's contract with Al Nassr is set to expire. That's according to Sport, which reports that the 27-year-old has his sights set on a return to the Champions League after a recent resurgence in his career in the Saudi Pro League. Felix previously spent a year on loan with Barcelona from Atletico Madrid, where he made 44 appearances with 10 goals and six assists. Now back in form, and eyeing a possible free transfer, a return to the Nou Camp is on his mind, though the report claims that he is not viewed as a priority target.

articles.headline: Cucurella: Too soon to judge Mourinho's Madrid amid poor start
articles.description: Marc Cucurella has acknowledged Real Madrid have not started the season as they would have liked under new coach José Mourinho, but he says the team must be judged at the end of the campaign, not now.
articles.headlineJa: ククレリャ：不調なスタートを切った今、モウリーニョ率いるマドリードを判断するには時期尚早
articles.descriptionJa: マルク・ククレリャは、新監督ジョゼ・モウリーニョのもと、レアル・マドリードが望んでいたようなシーズン開幕を迎えられていないことを認めているが、チームの評価は今ではなくシーズン終了時にすべきだと述べている。
articles.body:
Marc Cucurella has acknowledged Real Madrid have not started the season as they would have liked under new coach José Mourinho, but he says the team must be judged at the end of the campaign, not now.

Madrid have suffered two defeats in their opening seven LaLiga games, against Real Betis and Atlético Madrid, leaving them six points behind early leaders Barcelona.

- Torres forced out of Spain squad; Madrid's Espí gets 1st call-up

- De la Fuente says beloved Yamal puts 'magic' at service of Spain

- UEFA receives Madrid dossier on Barça-Negreira case

Cucurella, speaking in a news conference on Friday while on international duty with world champions Spain, said Madrid's new project needs time to take shape.

"It's all a process," Cucurella said. "With the national team, the foundations have been laid over many years -- with the [same] coach, too.

"At Madrid, we have just started with a new manager and it's too soon to speak. Some players only had a week-long preseason before starting.

"The beginning of the season hasn't been what we all hoped for, but it's a process and we will see where we are at the end of the campaign."

Cucurella has picked up where he left off for Spain at the World Cup in the summer, impressing in UEFA Nations League victories over England and Croatia during the last week.

It has led to suggestions the left back -- a €55 million ($62m) summer signing for Madrid from Chelsea -- is better suited to playing for his country than his club.

"It's not even been 10 games yet," Cucurella responded. "There are things to improve [with Madrid], of course. We basically had no preseason, while it's a new club for me.

"I have to adapt to my new teammates and give my best so that the player you see with the national team is the same player with Real Madrid."

Cucurella's form for Chelsea and Spain not only prompted Madrid to sign him in the summer, but also led to him being named among the 30 nominees to win this year's Ballon d'Or.

He is also in the rare position of playing alongside two of the favourites -- Kylian Mbappé with Madrid and Barcelona's Lamine Yamal with Spain -- but would not pick between the two.

"If it was up to me to vote, I would vote for myself," he joked when asked to name his winner.

"But no, two of the candidates to win it are teammates, so who whoever wins it, I will be happy."

Cucurella and Spain are back in action on Saturday when they host Czechia in Oviedo looking to make it three wins from three in the Nations League.

They then close the extended international break with a trip to Croatia on Tuesday.

articles.headline: New signing Carlos Baleba gets 1st Man United outing in friendly
articles.description: Carlos Baleba played his first minutes in a Manchester United shirt during a behind-closed-doors friendly on Friday.
articles.headlineJa: 新加入のカルロス・バレバ、親善試合でマンチェスター・ユナイテッド初出場
articles.descriptionJa: カルロス・バレバは金曜日に行われた非公開の親善試合で、マンチェスター・ユナイテッドとして初めての出場を果たした。
articles.body:
Carlos Baleba played his first minutes in a Manchester United shirt during a behind-closed-doors friendly on Friday.

The 22-year-old signed from Brighton in a £70 million ($93m) deal in August but has not featured in a competitive game due to an ankle injury sustained in preseason with the Seagulls.

He did make the bench for the 1-1 draw at Fulham immediately prior to the international break and has continued working towards full fitness at the club's Carrington training complex.

Baleba took part in a training game against Swiss side Lausanne-Sport alongside fellow first-teamers including Harry Maguire and Matheus Cunha.

Head coach Michael Carrick told club media recently that Baleba was "pushing to get back as quickly as possible" from injury.
